title: Rationalizing diverse binding mechanisms to the same protein fold: insights for ligand recognition and biosensor design
authors: Alison C. Leonard; Anika J. Friedman; Rachel Chayer; Brian M. Petersen; Joel Kaar; Michael R. Shirts; Timothy A. Whitehead
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蛋白-小分子配体结合机制与生物传感器设计，虽用MD和深度突变扫描，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The engineering of novel protein-ligand binding interactions, particularly for complex drug-like molecules, is an unsolved problem which could enable many practical applications of protein biosensors. In this work, we analyzed two engineer ed biosensors, derived from the plant hormone sensor PYR1, to recognize either the agrochemical mandipropamid or the synthetic cannabinoid WIN55,212-2. Using a combination of quantitative deep mutational scanning experiments and molecular dynamics simulations, we demonstrated that mutations at common positions can promote protein-ligand shape complementarity and revealed prominent differences in the electrostatic networks needed to complement diverse ligands. MD simulations indicate that both PYR1 protein-ligand complexes bind a single conformer of their target ligand that is close to the lowest free energy conformer. Computational design using a fixed conformer and rigid body orientation led to new WIN55,212-2 sensors with nanomolar limits of detection. This work reveals mechanisms by which the versatile PYR1 biosensor scaffold can bind diverse ligands. This work also provides computational methods to sample realistic ligand conformers and rigid body alignments that simplify the computational design of biosensors for novel ligands of interest.
abstract_zh: 新型蛋白质-配体结合相互作用的工程化，特别是针对复杂药物样分子，是一个尚未解决的问题，其解决有望推动蛋白质生物传感器的诸多实际应用。在本工作中，我们分析了两种工程化生物传感器，它们源自植物激素传感器PYR1，分别识别农用化学品双炔酰菌胺或合成大麻素WIN55,212-2。通过结合定量深度突变扫描实验和分子动力学模拟，我们证明了常见位置的突变能促进蛋白质-配体形状互补性，并揭示了为补充多样化配体所需的静电网络中的显著差异。分子动力学模拟表明，两种PYR1蛋白-配体复合物均结合其目标配体的单一构象，该构象接近最低自由能构象。使用固定构象和刚体取向的计算设计产生了具有纳摩尔级检测限的新型WIN55,212-2传感器。本工作揭示了多功能PYR1生物传感器支架结合多样化配体的机制，并提供了采样真实配体构象和刚体对齐的计算方法，从而简化了针对感兴趣新配体的生物传感器计算设计。
